The Disks test image at 512 x 512 with the defaults, after a Gaussian blur of growing sigma, rounded to 8 bits. Its disks have areas of about 113 to 16300 pixels, and the largest area allowed is 14400. On the image as it is, OpenCV finds no region. After a blur it finds some, and how many depends on the blur.
